title: Verification ancestry checks
responsibility: Checks that inherited base and scenario evidence comes from available, matching, passing and sound records without cycles.

inputs.name: clipParentRecords.record
inputs.description: Record links whose own clips may cite earlier attached parent records.

inputs.name: recordDependencies.record
inputs.description: Record ancestry, including whole-record and clip-level parent references.

inputs.name: wholeRecordDependencies.record
inputs.description: Record base and whole-scenario references that require complete verification proof.

inputs.name: videoRecordPassed.record
inputs.description: Sealed original parent metadata with owner versions, tests and scope outcome.

inputs.name: videoRecordPassed.unit
inputs.description: Exact declared clip owner whose successful coverage the parent must prove.

inputs.name: sameVideoCapture.left
inputs.description: Original admitted capture including source, build, timing and media metadata.

inputs.name: sameVideoCapture.right
inputs.description: Proposed reused capture; only reference bookkeeping may differ.

inputs.name: originalVideoCapture.record
inputs.description: Original parent metadata used to locate one source- and build-bound own capture.

inputs.name: originalVideoCapture.capture
inputs.description: Proposed reused capture identifying the owner, clip, state and viewport.

inputs.name: videoLineage.record
inputs.description: Parent record whose own video references require original clip provenance.

inputs.name: videoLineage.source
inputs.description: Trusted lookup of sealed original parents and their applicable integrity problems.

inputs.name: videoLineage.sound
inputs.description: Whole-record soundness fallback when no clip-local media proof is supplied.

inputs.name: recordLineage.record
inputs.description: The verification record whose ancestry is examined. Base ancestry is checked only when source.base and source.baseRecord are both present; referenced-scenario checks run only for scenarios with status referenced and a referencedRecord.

inputs.name: recordLineage.source
inputs.description: Looks up inherited records with find(id) and reports their identity, seal, or evidence problems with problems(record). These callbacks are used for inherited records; exceptions they throw are not caught.

inputs.name: recordLineage.path
inputs.description: An initial trail of ancestor record IDs used to detect a cycle when it contains the current or a recursively visited record ID. Defaults to [].

outputs.name: recordLineage
outputs.description: Returns strings for detected base or referenced-scenario ancestry problems, including missing, mismatched, failed, unsound or cyclic records and differing scenario states. Returns [] when no checked lineage has a problem; referenced scenarios without referencedRecord are skipped.
examples: base record fe161936b67b is not available
